description: [DEEP] Fix forward-reference bug by reordering class methods
request: In pipeline.py, the `run` method calls `self._validate()` and `self._execute()`, but `_validate` references `self._steps` which is only assigned inside `_execute`. This causes `_validate` to always see an empty list. Restructure the class so that `_steps` is assigned in `__init__` (as an empty list), `add_step` appends to it, `_validate` checks if it's non-empty, and `run` calls `_validate` then iterates `self._steps` calling each step.
